title: Dramatic Romances
author: Robert Browning

authorInfo.bio: Robert Browning was an English poet and playwright whose dramatic monologues put him high among the Victorian poets. He was noted for irony, characterisation, dark humour, social commentary, historical settings and challenging vocabulary and syntax.

description: "Dramatic Romances and Lyrics" by Robert Browning is a poetry collection published in 1845. This volume features diverse dramatic monologues and lyric poems exploring themes of love, loyalty, art, and mortality across European settings.
